title: Lugeon Value Calculation

Q.description: Steady-state flow rate at test pressure

L.description: Length of test interval between packers

P.description: Effective test pressure at interval midpoint

applicability: P = gauge pressure + hydrostatic head to interval center - friction loss in pipe. Valid for laminar flow only. For turbulent/dilating flow patterns, compute Lu at lowest pressure step. 1 Lu ≈ 1.3×10⁻⁷ m/s (approximate).

title: Approximate K from Lugeon Value
applicability: Order-of-magnitude approximation. Assumes specific borehole geometry (NX hole, 3 m interval). More precise conversion requires analytical or numerical solution for the specific test geometry. Useful for screening only.

title: Hvorslev Slug Test — Hydraulic Conductivity

Le.description: Length of well screen or open section

R.description: Radius of well screen or borehole (including filter pack)

T₀.description: Basic time lag = time for H/H₀ to reach 0.37 (1/e)

applicability: For uniform soil around well screen. Plot ln(H/H₀) vs. time → should be linear. T₀ from intercept at H/H₀ = 0.37. Non-linear plot indicates heterogeneity or well skin effects.

title: Bouwer-Rice Slug Test (Unconfined)

rc.description: Radius of well casing (where water level changes)

rw.description: Effective radius of well (including gravel pack)

Re.description: Effective radius of influence (from Bouwer-Rice empirical curves)

H₀, Ht.description: Head difference at t=0 and at time t

applicability: For unconfined aquifers. ln(Re/rw) determined from dimensionless parameters A, B, C tabulated by Bouwer & Rice (depend on Le/rw and Lw/rw). Works for partially and fully penetrating wells.

title: Cooper-Jacob (Simplified Theis) — Pump Test

Δs.description: Drawdown per log cycle of time

t₀.description: Time intercept at zero drawdown (from semilog plot)

r.description: Distance from pumping well to observation well

applicability: For confined aquifers where u = r²S/(4Tt) < 0.05 (late-time data). Plot drawdown s vs. log(time). Fit straight line through late-time data. T from slope (Δs per log cycle), S from time-axis intercept.

title: Theis Well Function

s.description: Drawdown at distance r from pumping well at time t

applicability: For fully confined, homogeneous, isotropic aquifer of infinite extent. Type-curve matching: plot s vs. r²/t on log-log, overlay on W(u) vs. 1/u type curve. Match point gives T and S.

title: Maximum Safe Test Pressure (Packer Test)

P_max.description: Maximum allowable test pressure at interval

H_overburden.description: Depth of overburden above test interval midpoint

applicability: To prevent hydrofracture. USBR typically uses P_max = 1 psi per foot of overburden (22.6 kPa/m). Near-surface tests: reduce pressure to avoid jacking. Some standards limit to 0.5 × overburden stress for shallow tests (< 15 m).

title: Falling Head Test in Borehole (Hvorslev Shape Factor)

H₁, H₂.description: Head differences at start and end of time interval

applicability: Shape factors: F = 2.75D for flush-bottom casing (D = diameter). F = 2πL/ln(L/D) for uncased borehole of length L, diameter D (when L/D > 8). Multiple geometries tabulated in Hvorslev (1951).

title: Specific Capacity to Transmissivity (Empirical)

C.description: Empirical constant (1.0–1.5 for confined, 0.9–1.2 for unconfined)

applicability: Quick screening estimate from pump test data or well yield tests. Accuracy ±50%. More refined methods account for well efficiency, partial penetration, and aquifer type. Useful when full pump test analysis is not warranted.

title: Grouting Criterion from Lugeon Tests
equation: Grout if Lu > Lu_threshold (typically 3–10 Lu for dam foundations)

Lu.description: Lugeon value from water pressure test

applicability: USBR and USACE: grout curtain if Lu > 3–5 in dam foundation. Blanket grouting if Lu > 10 near surface. After grouting: verify by re-testing — target Lu < 3 (some agencies target Lu < 1 for critical structures). Houlsby criterion: grouting unlikely to be effective if Lu < 1.
